subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, older macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767, or should any narrow remaining UX piece be salvaged in a fresh PR?
rationale: The `maintainer` label blocks automatic cleanup, while current main overlaps most of the central setup goal and the branch still carries security and upgrade blockers.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR and point to the merged local Gateway setup implementation, asking for any remaining onboarding polish as a new focused PR.

options.title: Extract a narrow follow-up
options.body: Keep this open only long enough for a maintainer to extract a small UI-only improvement without the risky Gateway, auth, and installer changes.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR and point to the merged local Gateway setup implementation, asking for any remaining onboarding polish as a new focused PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the broader replacement path and is the clearest current-main owner for this macOS setup surface.
